chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q4 — Contextual Analysis (5 points)
chunks.content: AP Art History Q4, Contextual Analysis, 5 points (Tasks A–E, 1 point each, independent). A: accurately describe ONE visual characteristic of the shown work (this administration: the Forbidden City). B: accurately describe its historical function. C–E: accurately use visual and/or contextual evidence to explain how the work reflects its historical/cultural context, its purpose, and related connections. Describe = characteristics beyond naming; the explain tasks require specific evidence tied to context.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4A, 5/5
chunks.content: Q4 Contextual Analysis scored 5/5 — describes a visual characteristic and the historical function of the work, then uses specific contextual evidence to explain how it reflects its cultural/historical context. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4B, 3/5
chunks.content: Q4 scored 3/5 — earns the description/function points and one contextual explanation, but two explanation tasks fall short (context not specific or not clearly tied to the work). Mid-range profile.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4C, 1/5
chunks.content: Q4 scored 1/5 — earns only a single point (e.g. one accurate description) and does not complete the historical-function or contextual-explanation tasks with accurate, specific evidence.
